suite: the map (Map . Classic, the counts, the one selection on four surfaces, the view)
expect_red: [real] an anchor picked in the scene selects its feature's pin on the map

mutations.contract: An anchor picked in the scene selects its feature on the page, and the map wears that selection like every other surface.
mutations.note: Drops the page's scene-pick path (selectFromScene), so a pick in the scene selects nothing and the map's pin stays unlit. The first cut keyed the map's pins by node, which made two pins share an id and broke the suite's own selectors before the check was reached.
